chunks: Grateful to Him for His favours; so He chose him and guided him to the path that is straight,
ai.seo_question: How does gratitude lead to divine guidance and selection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the causal link between human gratitude (shukr) and divine selection (ijtibāʾ), illustrating how God elevates the grateful servant to a station of closeness. The 'straight path' (ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm) is often interpreted not merely as general guidance but as the specific path of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who serve as the ultimate exemplars of righteousness. This reflects the Shia principle that true gratitude necessitates following the divinely appointed guides to attain spiritual perfection.
